snippet.title: Cloudy with a Chance of Kittens | Steam Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam Link: https://ninjachompek.com/steam-cwacok

Cloudy with a Chance of Kittens is a cozy, Suika-inspired, game where adorable, dessert-shaped cats fall from the clouds. Merge them to score points, set up satisfying chains and combos, and unlock power-ups. Play for fun or brave obstacles and cheeky weather twists. 🐈

Merge adorable dessert-shaped cats to create larger felines, all the way up to the ultimate cat-ermelon! Collect points to unlock exciting power-ups and customize your gameplay. Play casually for fun or take on challenges as you navigate obstacles and changing weather conditions.
